name: ND Task Results
description: Read local verified task receipts and measured overlap with a separate MCP server registration.
instructions: Use task_results for verified task outcomes and observed overlap, and task_results_export for Markdown. Replace both absolute path placeholders before enabling this MCP registration in Settings > Agent capabilities > MCP Servers. Native extension installation alone does not register this server. Offline fixture timings exclude model latency, and concurrency does not establish child subagents.
